title: The Dharma of Neuroscience - The Triune Brain
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The teacher's talk highlights the importance of critically evaluating scientific information and challenging Western notions of human superiority, particularly in relation to brain function. Instead, they suggest that true liberation comes from embracing our wholeness and interconnectedness with the world around us, letting go of attachments to time, space, and distinctions between ourselves and others. By doing so, we can transcend dualistic thinking and experience a sense of unity and harmony with all things.
topics: Western scientific bias towards human superiority
